name: move-fog-unseen-wall
about: Fog of war on: a path search counts only the entities its player sees, and takes every other cell for free. A builder (sight 10) has a long resource divider ahead; the way round it to the north is closed by a wall 20 cells off. Seeing only the near end of the divider, it goes round either way (with the whole map in sight only the south is open).
random: whether the unit goes round the divider by the north or by the south
